name: leg to side
description: Bring one leg out to the side to stretch the inner thigh. It improves hip mobility and flexibility.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Lift one leg and let it open out to the side, keeping the other leg down.
Keep your hips squared and your lower back relaxed.
Hold the stretch gently, breathing steadily.
Return to the middle and repeat with the other leg.
